args.title: Juniper Labware: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
args.body:
• Apparel return rates have reached 24%, making returns a major cost driver for retailers (Juniper Labware article, "Retail returns logistics").
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth (~20%), per the same article.
• The companion piece notes that reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin.
